name: Non-amyloid Fibrillary Glomerulopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for Non-amyloid Fibrillary Glomerulopathy

criteria.description: Renal biopsy showing randomly arranged non-amyloid fibrils measuring 12-24 nm in diameter on electron microscopy
Positive immunofluorescence staining for polyclonal IgG and complement components (C3) in glomeruli
Presence of proteinuria, often nephrotic range, with or without hematuria and renal insufficiency
Negative Congo red staining to exclude amyloidosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Renal biopsy demonstrating characteristic fibrils on electron microscopy with positive immunofluorescence and exclusion of amyloidosis by negative Congo red staining, combined with clinical evidence of proteinuria or renal impairment.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires renal biopsy with electron microscopy and immunofluorescence studies.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically presents with heavy proteinuria exceeding 3.5 g/day

pathognomonic.symptomName: Electron microscopy revealing non-amyloid fibrils in glomeruli
pathognomonic.notes: Fibrils are randomly arranged and measure 12-24 nm
searchTerms: non-amyloid fibril deposits in kidney tissue
electron microscopy revealing unusual kidney fibers

pathognomonic.symptomName: Negative Congo red staining of renal tissue
searchTerms: kidney tissue negative for amyloid stain
no amyloid detected in renal biopsy
Congo red stain negative in kidney sample

common.notes: Peripheral edema common in nephrotic syndrome

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue related to chronic kidney disease
searchTerms: fatigue linked to chronic kidney failure
low energy due to kidney problems

rare.symptomName: Nephritic syndrome features (e.g., hypertension, hematuria with red cell casts)
searchTerms: kidney inflammation with high blood pressure
blood in urine with kidney swelling
nephritic syndrome with hematuria and hypertension

rare.notes: Occurs in a minority of cases over years

rare.symptomName: Systemic symptoms such as fever or weight loss
searchTerms: systemic signs like chills and losing weight

imaging: Electron microscopy showing randomly arranged non-amyloid fibrils 12-24 nm in diameter in glomeruli
genetic: No known specific genetic mutations identified
other: Negative Congo red staining to exclude amyloidosis
Positive immunofluorescence for polyclonal IgG and complement C3

distinguishingFeatures: Positive Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence
Fibrils smaller (8-12 nm) and arranged differently on electron microscopy
Microtubular structures larger than fibrils (30-50 nm) on electron microscopy

redFlags: Presence of systemic amyloidosis signs (to exclude)
references: Jennette JC, et al. Heptinstall's Pathology of the Kidney. 7th ed. 2015.
